# Valery Verkhoturov

> Senior Backend Developer specializing in Go. Works at RWB, building a financial
> reporting system with PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Apache Kafka and Apache Cassandra.
> Writes articles on Habr about OAuth in CLI apps, retrieval-augmented generation
> (RAG) with ChatGPT/YandexGPT, and LaTeX thesis automation.

## Links

- [GitHub](https://github.com/ValeryVerkhoturov): open-source code and profile
- [Telegram](https://t.me/ValerianaOfficinalis): direct contact
- [Habr](https://habr.com/ru/users/ValeryV/): articles and profile (Russian)

## Projects

- [wb-api-client](https://github.com/ValeryVerkhoturov/wb-api-client): auto-generated Wildberries Seller API clients in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, PHP, OneScript and C#, published daily to PyPI, npm, Maven Central, Packagist, NuGet and hub.oscript.io
- [json-streaming](https://github.com/ValeryVerkhoturov/json-streaming): Go library for streaming read/write of JSON arrays with constant memory usage, ~3x throughput over encoding/json
- [multiagent-golang](https://github.com/ValeryVerkhoturov/multiagent-golang): LLM-agnostic multi-agent framework based on layered parallel communication of agents
- [onescript-openapi-generator](https://github.com/ValeryVerkhoturov/onescript-openapi-generator): OpenAPI Generator plugin that generates a OneScript (opm) client from an OpenAPI 3 spec
- [vitepress-editorial-modernist](https://github.com/ValeryVerkhoturov/vitepress-editorial-modernist): CSS-only editorial-modernist theme layer for VitePress
- [mirea-kb2-programming-languages](https://github.com/ValeryVerkhoturov/mirea-kb2-programming-languages): XeLaTeX template for the MIREA "Programming Languages" course work
